name: Pusoy Dos
source:
Each of the Playing Card Suits owns and operates one of the top casinos — Diyamantes, Bastons, Espadas, and Pusos — in a fictional Filipino city with a booming gambling industry. 

Hearts has been brutally butchered and killed. Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades are now investigating the crime scene.

[From [url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/pusoy-dos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每个扑克牌套装都拥有并经营顶级赌场之一——Diyamantes、Bastons、Espadas和Pusos——位于一个虚构的菲律宾城市，赌博业蓬勃发展。

红心被残酷地屠杀和杀害。方块、梅花和黑桃现在正在调查犯罪现场。

[来自[url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/pusoy-dos]Itch.io[/url]]
